messages.content: Hey, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How are you feeling this week? Any changes to your readings or medications you want to note?
Doing alright I guess. One thing — I'm almost out of my metformin and apparently my doctor won't authorize a refill without writing a new script first.
Thanks for flagging that. I've logged the metformin concern. About how many doses do you have left, and have you had to miss any yet?
Maybe 4 or 5 pills. Haven't missed one yet but I'm getting close. The nearest pharmacy is 45 miles out and I don't really have a way to get there even if the script was ready.

I hear you, and I want to be straight with you — I'm not able to request the new script or help arrange a ride. Those are both outside what I can do right now. But being this close to running out of a diabetes medication is something your care nurse needs to know about, so I'm escalating this to them now.
Alright. Any idea how long before I hear something?
The median response time right now is 31 hours, though it can be quicker. I've also set your next check-in to follow up on this specifically. Hang in there — your nurse will be in touch.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
